title: Light Scottish Brussels Sprouts Gratin
description: A sour and aerated Scottish dish featuring Brussels sprouts in a fondue pot, perfect for a brunch mood, this tamasic friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional gratin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and add the chopped onion, cooking until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the trimmed Brussels sprouts to the skillet, cooking until they begin to brown.
In a small bowl, mix together the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the lemon juice mixture over the Brussels sprouts and stir to combine.
Transfer the Brussels sprouts mixture to a fondue pot and top with shredded Gruyere cheese and breadcrumbs.
Place the fondue pot under the broiler and cook until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the fondue pot from the oven and serve hot.
